highp vec4 sampleNearest(highp sampler2D source, inout highp vec2 uv, highp vec2 pixelSize, highp vec2 du, highp vec2 dv, highp vec2 texelScreenSize)
{
    highp vec2 uvTexelCoords = uv / pixelSize;
    highp vec2 texelCenter = round(uvTexelCoords) - vec2(0.5);
    highp vec2 texelOffset = uvTexelCoords - texelCenter;
    texelOffset = (((texelOffset - vec2(0.5)) * pixelSize) / texelScreenSize) + vec2(0.5);
    texelOffset = clamp(texelOffset, vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
    uv = (texelCenter + texelOffset) * pixelSize;
    return textureGrad(source, uv, du, dv);
}

highp vec4 sampleRGSS(highp sampler2D source, highp vec2 uv, highp vec2 pixelSize)
{
    highp vec2 du = dFdx(uv);
    highp vec2 dv = dFdy(uv);
    highp vec2 texelScreenSize = sqrt((du * du) + (dv * dv));
    highp float maxTexelSize = max(texelScreenSize.x, texelScreenSize.y);
    highp float minPixelSize = min(pixelSize.x, pixelSize.y);
    highp float transitionStart = minPixelSize * 1.0;
    highp float transitionEnd = minPixelSize * 2.0;
    highp float blendFactor = smoothstep(transitionStart, transitionEnd, maxTexelSize);
    highp float duLength = length(du);
    highp float dvLength = length(dv);
    highp float minDerivative = min(duLength, dvLength);
    highp float maxDerivative = max(duLength, dvLength);
    highp float effectiveDerivative = sqrt(minDerivative * maxDerivative);
    highp float mipLevelExact = max(0.0, log2(effectiveDerivative / minPixelSize));
    highp float mipLevelLow = floor(mipLevelExact);
    highp float mipLevelHigh = mipLevelLow + 1.0;
    highp float mipBlend = fract(mipLevelExact);
    highp vec4 rgssColorLow = vec4(0.0);
    highp vec4 rgssColorHigh = vec4(0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
    {
        highp vec2 sampleUV = uv + (_228[i] * pixelSize);
        rgssColorLow += textureLod(source, sampleUV, mipLevelLow);
        rgssColorHigh += textureLod(source, sampleUV, mipLevelHigh);
    }
    rgssColorLow *= 0.25;
    rgssColorHigh *= 0.25;
    highp vec4 rgssColor = mix(rgssColorLow, rgssColorHigh, vec4(mipBlend));
    highp vec2 param = uv;
    highp vec2 param_1 = pixelSize;
    highp vec2 param_2 = du;
    highp vec2 param_3 = dv;
    highp vec2 param_4 = texelScreenSize;
    highp vec4 _274 = sampleNearest(source, param, param_1, param_2, param_3, param_4);
    highp vec4 nearestColor = _274;
    return mix(nearestColor, rgssColor, vec4(blendFactor));
}

highp float toAbsorbance(highp float transmittance)
{
    return clamp(-log(max(transmittance, 9.9999997473787516355514526367188e-05)), 0.0, 4.0);
}

highp float deviceToLinearDepth(inout highp float deviceDepth)
{
    deviceDepth = (deviceDepth - 0.5) * 2.0;
    return _uniform_instance_00_01.ProjMat[3].z / (deviceDepth + _uniform_instance_00_01.ProjMat[2].z);
}

highp float normalizeDepth(highp float fragmentDeviceDepth)
{
    highp vec4 depthBoundsSample = texelFetch(_uniform_00_04, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0);
    highp float closestBoundLinearDepthNegated = depthBoundsSample.x;
    highp float closestBoundLinearDepth = -closestBoundLinearDepthNegated;
    highp float furthestBoundLinearDepth = depthBoundsSample.y;
    highp float param = fragmentDeviceDepth;
    highp float _334 = deviceToLinearDepth(param);
    highp float fragmentLinearDepth = _334;
    highp float range = max(furthestBoundLinearDepth - closestBoundLinearDepth, 9.9999997473787516355514526367188e-05);
    highp float depthWithinBounds = clamp(fragmentLinearDepth - closestBoundLinearDepth, 0.0, range);
    highp float depthWithHighPrecision = 0.75 * range;
    if (depthWithHighPrecision <= 10.0)
    {
        return depthWithinBounds / range;
    }
    else
    {
        if (depthWithinBounds <= 10.0)
        {
            return (depthWithinBounds / 10.0) * 0.75;
        }
        else
        {
            return 0.75 + (((depthWithinBounds - 10.0) / (range - 10.0)) * 0.25);
        }
    }
}

void addTransmittance(highp float transmittance)
{
    highp float coefficients[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        coefficients[i] = 0.0;
    }
    highp float param = transmittance;
    highp float absorbance = toAbsorbance(param);
    highp float param_1 = gl_FragCoord.z;
    highp float originalDepth = normalizeDepth(param_1);
    highp float depth = (originalDepth * 7.0) / 8.0;
    highp float averageAbsorbance = absorbance * (1.0 - depth);
    coefficients[0] = averageAbsorbance;
    int depthBinIndex = int(floor(originalDepth * 7.0));
    int treeIndex = depthBinIndex + 8;
    for (int waveletLevel = 0; waveletLevel <= 2; waveletLevel++)
    {
        int power = 2 - waveletLevel;
        int parentIndex = treeIndex >> 1;
        highp float indexAtParentLevel = float(parentIndex & ((1 << power) - 1));
        int isRightHalf = treeIndex & 1;
        int waveletSign = 1 - (isRightHalf << 1);
        highp float waveletWidth = exp2(float(-power));
        highp float waveletHeightScale = exp2(float(power) * 0.5);
        highp float depthOffsetRelativeToWavelet = depth - (waveletWidth * indexAtParentLevel);
        highp float distanceFromWaveletEdge = (float(isRightHalf) * waveletWidth) + (float(waveletSign) * depthOffsetRelativeToWavelet);
        highp float differenceCoefficient = (distanceFromWaveletEdge * waveletHeightScale) * absorbance;
        coefficients[parentIndex] = differenceCoefficient;
        treeIndex = parentIndex;
    }
    for (int attachmentIndex = 0; attachmentIndex < 2; attachmentIndex++)
    {
        for (int i_1 = 0; i_1 < 4; i_1++)
        {
            _frag_output_00_mgio[attachmentIndex][i_1] = coefficients[(attachmentIndex * 4) + i_1];
        }
    }
}

void executeAlphaOnlyPhase(highp float deviceDepth, highp float alpha)
{
    highp float param = 1.0 - alpha;
    addTransmittance(param);
}

layout(std140) uniform _uniform_00_01
{
    highp mat4 ProjMat;
} _uniform_instance_00_01;

layout(std140) uniform _uniform_00_03
{
    highp vec4 FogColor;
    highp float FogEnvironmentalStart;
    highp float FogEnvironmentalEnd;
    highp float FogRenderDistanceStart;
    highp float FogRenderDistanceEnd;
    highp float FogSkyEnd;
    highp float FogCloudsEnd;
} _uniform_instance_00_03;

uniform highp sampler2D _uniform_00_05;

layout(location = 0) out highp vec4 _frag_output_00[2];
highp vec4 _frag_output_00_mgio[2];
in highp vec4 _interface_variable_01;
in highp float _interface_variable_00;

highp float linear_fog_value(highp float vertexDistance, highp float fogStart, highp float fogEnd)
{
    if (vertexDistance <= fogStart)
    {
        return 0.0;
    }
    else
    {
        if (vertexDistance >= fogEnd)
        {
            return 1.0;
        }
    }
    return (vertexDistance - fogStart) / (fogEnd - fogStart);
}

highp float toAbsorbance(highp float transmittance)
{
    return clamp(-log(max(transmittance, 9.9999997473787516355514526367188e-05)), 0.0, 4.0);
}

highp float deviceToLinearDepth(inout highp float deviceDepth)
{
    deviceDepth = (deviceDepth - 0.5) * 2.0;
    return _uniform_instance_00_01.ProjMat[3].z / (deviceDepth + _uniform_instance_00_01.ProjMat[2].z);
}

highp float normalizeDepth(highp float fragmentDeviceDepth)
{
    highp vec4 depthBoundsSample = texelFetch(_uniform_00_05, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0);
    highp float closestBoundLinearDepthNegated = depthBoundsSample.x;
    highp float closestBoundLinearDepth = -closestBoundLinearDepthNegated;
    highp float furthestBoundLinearDepth = depthBoundsSample.y;
    highp float param = fragmentDeviceDepth;
    highp float _124 = deviceToLinearDepth(param);
    highp float fragmentLinearDepth = _124;
    highp float range = max(furthestBoundLinearDepth - closestBoundLinearDepth, 9.9999997473787516355514526367188e-05);
    highp float depthWithinBounds = clamp(fragmentLinearDepth - closestBoundLinearDepth, 0.0, range);
    highp float depthWithHighPrecision = 0.75 * range;
    if (depthWithHighPrecision <= 10.0)
    {
        return depthWithinBounds / range;
    }
    else
    {
        if (depthWithinBounds <= 10.0)
        {
            return (depthWithinBounds / 10.0) * 0.75;
        }
        else
        {
            return 0.75 + (((depthWithinBounds - 10.0) / (range - 10.0)) * 0.25);
        }
    }
}

void addTransmittance(highp float transmittance)
{
    highp float coefficients[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        coefficients[i] = 0.0;
    }
    highp float param = transmittance;
    highp float absorbance = toAbsorbance(param);
    highp float param_1 = gl_FragCoord.z;
    highp float originalDepth = normalizeDepth(param_1);
    highp float depth = (originalDepth * 7.0) / 8.0;
    highp float averageAbsorbance = absorbance * (1.0 - depth);
    coefficients[0] = averageAbsorbance;
    int depthBinIndex = int(floor(originalDepth * 7.0));
    int treeIndex = depthBinIndex + 8;
    for (int waveletLevel = 0; waveletLevel <= 2; waveletLevel++)
    {
        int power = 2 - waveletLevel;
        int parentIndex = treeIndex >> 1;
        highp float indexAtParentLevel = float(parentIndex & ((1 << power) - 1));
        int isRightHalf = treeIndex & 1;
        int waveletSign = 1 - (isRightHalf << 1);
        highp float waveletWidth = exp2(float(-power));
        highp float waveletHeightScale = exp2(float(power) * 0.5);
        highp float depthOffsetRelativeToWavelet = depth - (waveletWidth * indexAtParentLevel);
        highp float distanceFromWaveletEdge = (float(isRightHalf) * waveletWidth) + (float(waveletSign) * depthOffsetRelativeToWavelet);
        highp float differenceCoefficient = (distanceFromWaveletEdge * waveletHeightScale) * absorbance;
        coefficients[parentIndex] = differenceCoefficient;
        treeIndex = parentIndex;
    }
    for (int attachmentIndex = 0; attachmentIndex < 2; attachmentIndex++)
    {
        for (int i_1 = 0; i_1 < 4; i_1++)
        {
            _frag_output_00_mgio[attachmentIndex][i_1] = coefficients[(attachmentIndex * 4) + i_1];
        }
    }
}

void executeAlphaOnlyPhase(highp float deviceDepth, highp float alpha)
{
    highp float param = 1.0 - alpha;
    addTransmittance(param);
}

void main()
{
    highp vec4 color = _interface_variable_01;
    highp float param = _interface_variable_00;
    highp float param_1 = 0.0;
    highp float param_2 = _uniform_instance_00_03.FogCloudsEnd;
    color.w *= (1.0 - linear_fog_value(param, param_1, param_2));
    highp float param_3 = gl_FragCoord.z;
    highp float param_4 = color.w;
    executeAlphaOnlyPhase(param_3, param_4);

    // mg: constant-index fragment-output copies (ESSL 300, Task183)
    _frag_output_00[0] = _frag_output_00_mgio[0];
    _frag_output_00[1] = _frag_output_00_mgio[1];
}
